channel.title: Wire — Cloud
channel.description: Cloud from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Sudden drop in Cloudflare bot traffic after strike on Yandex datacenter
Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports custom Tooling blueprints
item.description: Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio now supports custom Tooling blueprints, giving domain administrators the ability to define the foundation of every project by using their own AWS CloudFormation templates. (1 source: aws)

item.title: TwelveLabs Pegasus 1.5 model now available on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Amazon Bedrock now supports TwelveLabs Pegasus 1.5, a video-to-text model that generates structured, time-coded metadata from video. (1 source: aws)

item.title: AWS Introduces Enhanced Custom Event Buses for EventBridge
item.description: AWS recently announced enhanced custom event buses for Amazon EventBridge, allowing organizations to share a centralized bus across accounts with ordered delivery, simplified subscriber management, event replay, content-based… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS Network Firewall adds wildcard support for container attribute filters
item.description: AWS Network Firewall now supports wildcard matching in container attribute-based inspection filters for Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) and Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon GuardDuty RDS Protection now detects data exfiltration and destruction in Aurora and RDS databases
item.description: Amazon GuardDuty announces an expansion of RDS Protection that extends threat detection beyond login anomalies to identify data exfiltration and data destruction attacks targeting Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL… (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon GameLift Servers adds CPU burstability for container fleets
item.description: Amazon GameLift Servers now supports CPU burstability for container fleets, giving game developers greater flexibility in how compute resources are allocated and consumed at runtime. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EC2 C8gb instances now generally available in additional regions
item.description: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C8gb instances, powered by the latest-generation AWS Graviton4 processors, are available in the US East (Ohio), US West (N. (1 source: aws)
